screen.description: whole-dwell lag-four differential pilot proposal; approximate CFO-tolerant proposal evidence, not physical absence evidence

variants.name: rank_max_score
variants.statistic: maximum of six native rank scores

variants.name: sparse_lag3_power
variants.statistic: root-mean-square across the six independently normalized three-frame-lag correlation magnitudes

development_threshold_rule: For each statistic, choose the inclusive minimum among the 36 development reference-positive receiver-visits, then report every routed receiver-visit. Do not use synthetic controls to choose or alter the threshold.

timing.scope: thread CPU and monotonic wall around RX selection/contiguous packing plus one complete screen call; input hashing, file loading, and file hash verification excluded

controls.use: report independently after development thresholds are fixed; never tune thresholds from controls

interpretation.not_routed: measured-screen-negative only; never confirmed absence, noise truth, or completed processing
interpretation.five_ms_transfer: unverified because development has no 5 MS/s reference positives
